s0101.literal: On jihai day the daughter of the Emperor's elder sister Princess Shouning, Sadabala, was received into the central palace.
s0101.idiomatic: On jihai day the daughter of the Emperor's elder sister Princess Shouning, Sadabala, was received into the central palace.

s0102.literal: Yao of Lisuo Source in Daozhou Route became bandits; Qizhu was ordered to supervise troops to capture them.
s0102.idiomatic: Yao of Lisuo Source in Daozhou Route became bandits; Qizhu was ordered to supervise troops to capture them.

s0103.literal: Subordinate counties of Fengyuan and Gongchang suffered heavy rain and hail; Xia Prefecture had drought; subordinate counties of Dongping had locusts; subordinate counties of Datong had great flooding; smelting households at Laiwu and elsewhere suffered famine; thirty thousand ingots of notes were granted in relief.
s0103.idiomatic: Subordinate counties of Fengyuan and Gongchang suffered heavy rain and hail; Xia Prefecture had drought; subordinate counties of Dongping had locusts; subordinate counties of Datong had great flooding; smelting households at Laiwu and elsewhere suffered famine; 30,000 ingots of notes were granted in relief.

s0104.literal: Guang Prefecture had flooding; Anxi County of Zhongshan suffered hail damaging crops; the Dachang Tuntun River burst its banks; subordinate counties of Daining, Lu, De'an, Wu, and Zhongqing routes suffered flood and drought; all had rents remitted.
s0104.idiomatic: Guang Prefecture had flooding; Anxi County of Zhongshan suffered hail damaging crops; the Dachang Tuntun River burst its banks; subordinate counties of Daining, Lu, De'an, Wu, and Zhongqing routes suffered flood and drought; all had rents remitted.

s0105.literal: Seventh month of autumn, on jiachen day the imperial carriage departed Shangdu; riding in chariots and on horses was forbidden to trample the people's grain.
s0105.idiomatic: Seventh month of autumn, on jiachen day the imperial carriage departed Shangdu; riding in chariots and on horses was forbidden to trample the people's grain.

s0106.literal: Liao King Tuotuo requested restoration of garrison troops for Grand Empress Dowager Yeyelun's palace and Jurchen tuntun households; not approved.
s0106.idiomatic: Liao King Tuotuo requested restoration of garrison troops for Grand Empress Dowager Yeyelun's palace and Jurchen tuntun households; not approved.

s0107.literal: The annual grants to Taizu's four great ordos were increased by two hundred ingots of silver and eight thousand ingots of notes.
s0107.idiomatic: The annual grants to Taizu's four great ordos were increased by 200 ingots of silver and 8,000 ingots of notes.

s0108.literal: Envoys were dispatched to sacrifice to the sea god Tianfei.
s0108.idiomatic: Envoys were dispatched to sacrifice to the sea god Tianfei.

s0109.literal: Thirty felt carts for rearing leopards were constructed.
s0109.idiomatic: 30 felt carts for rearing leopards were constructed.

s0110.literal: On yisi day qielian tuntian fields suffered frost; two months' grain was granted in relief.
s0110.idiomatic: On yisi day qielian tuntian fields suffered frost; 2 months' grain was granted in relief.

s0111.literal: On bingwu day sacrifice was performed at the Imperial Ancestral Temple.
s0111.idiomatic: On bingwu day sacrifice was performed at the Imperial Ancestral Temple.

s0112.literal: On dingwei day Ran Shichang of Youyang Stockade in Shaoqing and He're Cave barbarians became bandits.
s0112.idiomatic: On dingwei day Ran Shichang of Youyang Stockade in Shaoqing and He're Cave barbarians became bandits.

s0113.literal: Edict: palace camels and horses and imperial kin and generals stationed for winter on the northern frontier shall not come to the capital without authorization.
s0113.idiomatic: Edict: palace camels and horses and imperial kin and generals stationed for winter on the northern frontier shall not come to the capital without authorization.

s0114.literal: On xinhai day Aduchi was enfeoffed Prince of Suining and granted four thousand ingots of notes; a gold seal was given.
s0114.idiomatic: On xinhai day Aduchi was enfeoffed Prince of Suining and granted 4,000 ingots of notes; a gold seal was given.

s0115.literal: On renzi day the Empress received the Yaman Dagha precepts at the Crystal Hall.
s0115.idiomatic: On renzi day the Empress received the Yaman Dagha precepts at the Crystal Hall.

s0116.literal: On jiayin day the Emperor visited Dagan Yuan Temple and ordered casting of bronze images of the Five Direction Buddhas.
s0116.idiomatic: On jiayin day the Emperor visited Dagan Yuan Temple and ordered casting of bronze images of the Five Direction Buddhas.

s0117.literal: On yimao day an edict directed Hanlin exposition academician Aruwei and regular academician Yanchi to translate The Holy Instructions of Shizu for presentation at the classics mat lectures.
s0117.idiomatic: On yimao day an edict directed Hanlin exposition academician Aruwei and regular academician Yanchi to translate The Holy Instructions of Shizu for presentation at the classics mat lectures.

s0118.literal: On wuwu day Prince Busain presented camels and horses.
s0118.idiomatic: On wuwu day Prince Busain presented camels and horses.

s0119.literal: Forty Japanese monks including Ruixing were dispatched to return to their country.
s0119.idiomatic: 40 Japanese monks including Ruixing were dispatched to return to their country.

s0120.literal: A separate hall was built at the latent residence.
s0120.idiomatic: A separate hall was built at the latent residence.

s0121.literal: Edict: "Those who donate grain for appointment to office shall be assessed according to the criteria for retired officials.
s0121.idiomatic: Edict: "Those who donate grain for appointment to office shall be assessed according to the criteria for retired officials.

s0122.literal: " On jiwei day princesses of the various princely establishments were forbidden to enter the capital to report famine.
s0122.idiomatic: On jiwei day princesses of the various princely establishments were forbidden to enter the capital to report famine.

s0123.literal: Yelü Temür inherited the enfeoffment as Prince of Qi; a gold seal was given.
s0123.idiomatic: Yelü Temür inherited the enfeoffment as Prince of Qi; a gold seal was given.

s0124.literal: The Babai Xifu barbarians of Zhaonantong sent envoys presenting tribute of tame elephants and local products.
s0124.idiomatic: The Babai Xifu barbarians of Zhaonantong sent envoys presenting tribute of tame elephants and local products.

s0125.literal: On yichou day troops were dispatched to repair the three mountain pass roads of Yehu, Seze, and Sanggan.
s0125.idiomatic: On yichou day troops were dispatched to repair the three mountain pass roads of Yehu, Seze, and Sanggan.

s0126.literal: On wuchen day Venus crossed the sky.
s0126.idiomatic: On wuchen day Venus crossed the sky.

s0127.literal: On jisi day Ninang, native official of Dali, came to present local products.
s0127.idiomatic: On jisi day Ninang, native official of Dali, came to present local products.

s0128.literal: On gengshen day Guangxi branch pacification vice commissioner Wang Rui requested increased garrison troops and that native people conduct tuntian farming to guard against barbarians; the Nanning Pacification Commission was also established.
s0128.idiomatic: On gengshen day Guangxi branch pacification vice commissioner Wang Rui requested increased garrison troops and that native people conduct tuntian farming to guard against barbarians; the Nanning Pacification Commission was also established.

s0129.literal: The Yellow River burst its banks at Zheng Prefecture and Yangwu County, sweeping away more than sixteen thousand five hundred households; relief was granted.
s0129.idiomatic: The Yellow River burst its banks at Zheng Prefecture and Yangwu County, sweeping away more than 16,500 households; relief was granted.

s0130.literal: Subordinate counties of Yongping and Dadu had flooding, great wind, and hail.
s0130.idiomatic: Subordinate counties of Yongping and Dadu had flooding, great wind, and hail.

s0131.literal: Longxing and Chen Prefecture routes had fire; Daye, Yongping, Fengyuan, and other route subordinate counties had drought; Bianliang Route had flooding; Daye, Shunde, Weihui, Huai'an routes and Sui, Zhao, Zhuo, Ba prefectures and princely estate tuntian had locusts; Datong's Hunyuan River overflowed; Tan and Shun prefectures had two rivers burst; Wenyu River overflowed; seventy thousand ingots of notes were granted in relief to Yongping and Fengyuan.
s0131.idiomatic: Longxing and Chen Prefecture routes had fire; Daye, Yongping, Fengyuan, and other route subordinate counties had drought; Bianliang Route had flooding; Daye, Shunde, Weihui, Huai'an routes and Sui, Zhao, Zhuo, Ba prefectures and princely estate tuntian had locusts; Datong's Hunyuan River overflowed; Tan and Shun prefectures had two rivers burst; Wenyu River overflowed; 70,000 ingots of notes were granted in relief to Yongping and Fengyuan.

s0132.literal: Thirty-nine thousand-plus shi of wheat were issued and sold at reduced prices to relieve the famished people of Hao Prefecture.
s0132.idiomatic: 39,000-plus shi of wheat were issued and sold at reduced prices to relieve the famished people of Hao Prefecture.

s0133.literal: Orders were issued to bury abandoned corpses outside the capital; where cause of death was unclear, officials were to investigate.
s0133.idiomatic: Orders were issued to bury abandoned corpses outside the capital; where cause of death was unclear, officials were to investigate.

s0134.literal: Eighth month, on jiaxu day Wubadu and Xu Shijing both requested resignation of their administrative authority on account of calamities, famine, and crop failure; not approved.
s0134.idiomatic: Eighth month, on jiaxu day Wubadu and Xu Shijing both requested resignation of their administrative authority on account of calamities, famine, and crop failure; not approved.

s0135.literal: On yihai day Namatai was dispatched to inspect frontier troops; one thousand ingots of notes were granted.
s0135.idiomatic: On yihai day Namatai was dispatched to inspect frontier troops; 1,000 ingots of notes were granted.

s0136.literal: The Spirit Hall at Datianyuan Yansheng Temple was completed.
s0136.idiomatic: The Spirit Hall at Datianyuan Yansheng Temple was completed.

s0137.literal: On wuyin day the Chengqingshi Sluice Gate was repaired.
s0137.idiomatic: On wuyin day the Chengqingshi Sluice Gate was repaired.

s0138.literal: On jiashen day sacrifice was performed at the Imperial Ancestral Temple.
s0138.idiomatic: On jiashen day sacrifice was performed at the Imperial Ancestral Temple.

s0139.literal: Daoist priest Lan Daoyuan of Changchun Palace was dismissed on account of crime.
s0139.idiomatic: Daoist priest Lan Daoyuan of Changchun Palace was dismissed on account of crime.

s0140.literal: Edict: "Daoist priests who have wives shall all be subject to corvée.
s0140.idiomatic: Edict: "Daoist priests who have wives shall all be subject to corvée.

s0141.literal: " Two hundred fifty households of Yellow Sheep Slope were relocated to the Tatar department.
s0141.idiomatic: Two hundred fifty households of Yellow Sheep Slope were relocated to the Tatar department.

s0142.literal: Diao Yong, cave barbarian of Ningyuan Prefecture, became bandits; the Yunnan Branch Secretariat was ordered to prepare against them.
s0142.idiomatic: Diao Yong, cave barbarian of Ningyuan Prefecture, became bandits; the Yunnan Branch Secretariat was ordered to prepare against them.

s0143.literal: On dinghai day Prince of Liang Wang Chan was dispatched to regulate frontier affairs at Ordos.
s0143.idiomatic: On dinghai day Prince of Liang Wang Chan was dispatched to regulate frontier affairs at Ordos.

s0144.literal: On xinmao day Yunnan Branch Secretariat chancellor Yierji and surveillance vice commissioner Sanzhiutai, while drunk, insulted each other; the matter was reported; an edict pardoned both.
s0144.idiomatic: On xinmao day Yunnan Branch Secretariat chancellor Yierji and surveillance vice commissioner Sanzhiutai, while drunk, insulted each other; the matter was reported; an edict pardoned both.

s0145.literal: On jiawu day hunting was suspended on account of calamities.
s0145.idiomatic: On jiawu day hunting was suspended on account of calamities.

s0146.literal: Henan tammaqchi troops were granted relief; their remaining adult males were registered.
s0146.idiomatic: Henan tammaqchi troops were granted relief; their remaining adult males were registered.

s0147.literal: The mobile Bureau of Buddhist Affairs and the Merit Commission were abolished; arrears of weapons owed to the Armory Directorate were remitted.
s0147.idiomatic: The mobile Bureau of Buddhist Affairs and the Merit Commission were abolished; arrears of weapons owed to the Armory Directorate were remitted.

s0148.literal: On dingyou day Prince Busain dispatched envoys presenting jade and Bactrian camels.
s0148.idiomatic: On dingyou day Prince Busain dispatched envoys presenting jade and Bactrian camels.

s0149.literal: That night Venus encroached upon Xuanyuan's Consort Maid.
s0149.idiomatic: That night Venus encroached upon Xuanyuan's Consort Maid.

s0150.literal: On account of the stellar anomaly, an edict showing care for the people was issued.
s0150.idiomatic: On account of the stellar anomaly, an edict showing care for the people was issued.

s0151.literal: On xinchou day the Emperor stopped at Zhongdu and hunted at Wanghuochatu.
s0151.idiomatic: On xinchou day the Emperor stopped at Zhongdu and hunted at Wanghuochatu.

s0152.literal: Grand Preceptor Atanchu was granted two thousand eight hundred ingots of notes.
s0152.idiomatic: Grand Preceptor Atanchu was granted 2,800 ingots of notes.

s0154.literal: Gansu Zhahun Granary was abolished; its military provisions were moved to Wanghula Granary.
s0154.idiomatic: Gansu Zhahun Granary was abolished; its military provisions were moved to Wanghula Granary.

s0155.literal: Minister of Revenue Guo Liang was dismissed on account of corruption.
s0155.idiomatic: Minister of Revenue Guo Liang was dismissed on account of corruption.

s0156.literal: A Tianfei Palace was built at Haijin Town.
s0156.idiomatic: A Tianfei Palace was built at Haijin Town.

s0157.literal: Western Tibet native official Sajia Bu came to present local products; sea bandit Li San came to submit.
s0157.idiomatic: Western Tibet native official Sajia Bu came to present local products; sea bandit Li San came to submit.

s0158.literal: An edict was issued instructing diver households of Lian Prefecture to resume their occupations.
s0158.idiomatic: An edict was issued instructing diver households of Lian Prefecture to resume their occupations.

s0159.literal: Yanguan Prefecture had great wind; the sea overflowed; more than thirty li of dikes were destroyed; envoys were dispatched to sacrifice to the sea god — this did not stop it; one thousand two hundred fifty households were relocated.
s0159.idiomatic: Yanguan Prefecture had great wind; the sea overflowed; more than 30 li of dikes were destroyed; envoys were dispatched to sacrifice to the sea god — this did not stop it; 1,250 households were relocated.

s0160.literal: Changping in Dadu had great wind, destroying nine hundred households' dwellings.
s0160.idiomatic: Changping in Dadu had great wind, destroying 900 households' dwellings.

s0161.literal: Longqing Route had hail one chi deep and great wind damaging crops.
s0161.idiomatic: Longqing Route had hail 1 chi deep and great wind damaging crops.

s0162.literal: Li County of Zhen Prefecture, Pucheng and other counties of Fengyuan, and Wuwei Prefecture and other places had flooding; Hezhong Prefecture, Yongping, Jianchang Yindu, Zhongqing, Taiping routes and Guangxi's Two Rivers suffered famine — grain was issued for relief in all cases.
s0162.idiomatic: Li County of Zhen Prefecture, Pucheng and other counties of Fengyuan, and Wuwei Prefecture and other places had flooding; Hezhong Prefecture, Yongping, Jianchang Yindu, Zhongqing, Taiping routes and Guangxi's Two Rivers suffered famine — grain was issued for relief in all cases.

s0163.literal: Chongming Prefecture of Yang Prefecture had great wind and rain; the sea overflowed; coffins and burial were provided for the drowned.
s0163.idiomatic: Chongming Prefecture of Yang Prefecture had great wind and rain; the sea overflowed; coffins and burial were provided for the drowned.

s0164.literal: Hang Prefecture had fire; one month's grain was granted in relief.
s0164.idiomatic: Hang Prefecture had fire; 1 month's grain was granted in relief.

s0165.literal: Ninth month, on dingwei day one additional deputy to the Shangdu Intendant was established, concurrently serving as investigating magistrate.
s0165.idiomatic: Ninth month, on dingwei day one additional deputy to the Shangdu Intendant was established, concurrently serving as investigating magistrate.

s0166.literal: On xinhai day the Imperial Preceptor was ordered to return to the capital and perform purification Buddhist rites at the three palaces of Daming, Xingsheng, and Longfu.
s0166.idiomatic: On xinhai day the Imperial Preceptor was ordered to return to the capital and perform purification Buddhist rites at the three palaces of Daming, Xingsheng, and Longfu.

s0167.literal: On dingsi day the liquor prohibition in Dadu, Shangdu, and Xinghe was relaxed.
s0167.idiomatic: On dingsi day the liquor prohibition in Dadu, Shangdu, and Xinghe was relaxed.

s0168.literal: On gengshen day the imperial carriage arrived at Dadu.
s0168.idiomatic: On gengshen day the imperial carriage arrived at Dadu.

s0169.literal: On renxu day Chana was put in charge of revenue affairs.
s0169.idiomatic: On renxu day Chana was put in charge of revenue affairs.

s0170.literal: On guihai day Venus encroached upon Right Enforcer of the Supreme Palace Enclosure.
s0170.idiomatic: On guihai day Venus encroached upon Right Enforcer of the Supreme Palace Enclosure.

s0171.literal: Seventy-five newly submitted barbarian officials of Dacheli were granted fur coats, caps, boots, and stockings.
s0171.idiomatic: 75 newly submitted barbarian officials of Dacheli were granted fur coats, caps, boots, and stockings.

s0172.literal: On wuchen day Huanchi and others were appointed envoys to the three princely establishments of Qiebie, Yuesibie, and Busain.
s0172.idiomatic: On wuchen day Huanchi and others were appointed envoys to the three princely establishments of Qiebie, Yuesibie, and Busain.

s0173.literal: Two hundred thousand ingots of notes were granted in relief to the poor of the latent residence.
s0173.idiomatic: 200,000 ingots of notes were granted in relief to the poor of the latent residence.

s0174.literal: Guo Fu, route administrator of Taiping Route, Huguang Branch Secretariat; Ai Pei, stockade chief of Tula Stockade, Weichu Route, Yunnan Branch Secretariat; A'wu, son of Azinong, stockade chief of Jingdong Stockade; Nidao, younger brother of the stockade master of Da'a'ai Stockade; Ai Bolli, stockade chief of Mula Stockade; Ali, native official of Mangshi Route; Tuojin Ke, younger brother of Ningnang, native official of Zhenkang Route; Qiuluo, native official of Munian Route; Ai Yong, nephew of Zhao'ai of Dacheli; Wuzhong, native official of Menglong District — all came presenting local products.
s0174.idiomatic: Guo Fu, route administrator of Taiping Route, Huguang Branch Secretariat; Ai Pei, stockade chief of Tula Stockade, Weichu Route, Yunnan Branch Secretariat; A'wu, son of Azinong, stockade chief of Jingdong Stockade; Nidao, younger brother of the stockade master of Da'a'ai Stockade; Ai Bolli, stockade chief of Mula Stockade; Ali, native official of Mangshi Route; Tuojin Ke, younger brother of Ningnang, native official of Zhenkang Route; Qiuluo, native official of Munian Route; Ai Yong, nephew of Zhao'ai of Dacheli; Wuzhong, native official of Menglong District — all came presenting local products.

s0175.literal: Based on Zhao'ai's territory one Muduo Route, one Mulai Prefecture, and three districts were established; based on Wuzhong's territory one Menglong Route and one district; based on Ai Pei's territory one district — gold talismans and bronze seals were granted, and silks and saddle trappings were granted in varying amounts.
s0175.idiomatic: Based on Zhao'ai's territory 1 Muduo Route, 1 Mulai Prefecture, and 3 districts were established; based on Wuzhong's territory 1 Menglong Route and 1 district; based on Ai Pei's territory 1 district — gold talismans and bronze seals were granted, and silks and saddle trappings were granted in varying amounts.

s0176.literal: Central Secretariat officials stated: "State revenues are now insufficient; Your Majesty ought to take Emperor Shizu's diligence and frugality as an everlasting plan.
s0176.idiomatic: Central Secretariat officials stated: "State revenues are now insufficient; Your Majesty ought to take Emperor Shizu's diligence and frugality as an everlasting plan.

s0177.literal: We who serve in office, should any among us improperly receive imperial rewards, shall certainly memorialize in return.
s0177.idiomatic: We who serve in office, should any among us improperly receive imperial rewards, shall certainly memorialize in return.

s0178.literal: " The Emperor commended and accepted this.
s0178.idiomatic: The Emperor commended and accepted this.

s0179.literal: Subordinate counties of Yang, Ning, and Jiande had flooding; Nan'en Prefecture had drought; the people suffered famine — all were relieved.
s0179.idiomatic: Subordinate counties of Yang, Ning, and Jiande had flooding; Nan'en Prefecture had drought; the people suffered famine — all were relieved.

s0180.literal: Pingyao County of Fen Prefecture — the Fen River overflowed; Lu and Huaiqing routes had locusts.
s0180.idiomatic: Pingyao County of Fen Prefecture — the Fen River overflowed; Lu and Huaiqing routes had locusts.

s0181.literal: Winter, tenth month, on xinwei new moon, four thousand laborers were dispatched to repair the Tong Prefecture road; one thousand six hundred ingots of notes were granted.
s0181.idiomatic: Winter, tenth month, on xinwei new moon, 4,000 laborers were dispatched to repair the Tong Prefecture road; 1,600 ingots of notes were granted.

s0182.literal: On jiaxu day Niuzhe was promoted to right censor-in-chief.
s0182.idiomatic: On jiaxu day Niuzhe was promoted to right censor-in-chief.

s0183.literal: On gengchen day sacrifice was performed at the Imperial Ancestral Temple.
s0183.idiomatic: On gengchen day sacrifice was performed at the Imperial Ancestral Temple.

s0184.literal: Emperor Xianzong's imperial portrait was installed at Datianyuan Yansheng Temple.
s0184.idiomatic: Emperor Xianzong's imperial portrait was installed at Datianyuan Yansheng Temple.

s0185.literal: On xinsi day Venus encroached upon Worthies.
s0185.idiomatic: On xinsi day Venus encroached upon Worthies.

s0186.literal: On the Tianshou Festival, Daoist priests were dispatched to sacrifice at Weihui Taiyi Wanshou Palace.
s0186.idiomatic: On the Tianshou Festival, Daoist priests were dispatched to sacrifice at Weihui Taiyi Wanshou Palace.

s0187.literal: On renwu day the Imperial Preceptor returned to Sasija due to illness; gold, silver, notes, and silks numbering in the tens of thousands were granted; the Central Secretariat was ordered to dispatch officials to accompany him and supply his provisions.
s0187.idiomatic: On renwu day the Imperial Preceptor returned to Sasija due to illness; gold, silver, notes, and silks numbering in the tens of thousands were granted; the Central Secretariat was ordered to dispatch officials to accompany him and supply his provisions.

s0188.literal: On guiyou day the Yellow River overflowed; the Lele Dike of Bianliang Route was damaged; sixty-four thousand laborers were conscripted to repair it.
s0188.idiomatic: On guiyou day the Yellow River overflowed; the Lele Dike of Bianliang Route was damaged; 64,000 laborers were conscripted to repair it.

s0189.literal: The capital suffered famine; eight hundred thousand shi of grain were issued and sold at reduced prices.
s0189.idiomatic: The capital suffered famine; 800,000 shi of grain were issued and sold at reduced prices.

s0190.literal: Datianyuan Yansheng Temple was granted twenty thousand ingots of notes and one thousand qing of fields in Ji'an and Linjiang circuits.
s0190.idiomatic: Datianyuan Yansheng Temple was granted 20,000 ingots of notes and 1,000 qing of fields in Ji'an and Linjiang circuits.

s0191.literal: Central Secretariat officials stated: "To support soldiers and civilians, one must rely on the bounty of the land.
s0191.idiomatic: Central Secretariat officials stated: "To support soldiers and civilians, one must rely on the bounty of the land.

s0192.literal: Shizu built Daxuanwen Hongjiao and other temples and granted perpetual estates — even then it was already called wasteful spending; Chengzong again constructed Tianshou Wannning Temple, and compared with Shizu the expenditure increased by half again.
s0192.idiomatic: Shizu built Daxuanwen Hongjiao and other temples and granted perpetual estates — even then it was already called wasteful spending; Chengzong again constructed Tianshou Wannning Temple, and compared with Shizu the expenditure increased by half again.

s0193.literal: As for Wuzong's Chong'en Fuyuan and Renzong's Chenghua Puqing, the revenue from land rents and monopolies was greater still.
s0193.idiomatic: As for Wuzong's Chong'en Fuyuan and Renzong's Chenghua Puqing, the revenue from land rents and monopolies was greater still.

s0194.literal: Yingzong cut through mountains to open temples, harming soldiers and farmers, yet in the end to no benefit.
s0194.idiomatic: Yingzong cut through mountains to open temples, harming soldiers and farmers, yet in the end to no benefit.

s0195.literal: The land belongs to the ancestors; descendants ought jointly to cherish it.
s0195.idiomatic: The land belongs to the ancestors; descendants ought jointly to cherish it.

s0196.literal: We fear that hereafter this may be used as a pretext to wantonly launch labor projects and seek blessings to indulge private desires — may Your Majesty examine this.
s0196.idiomatic: We fear that hereafter this may be used as a pretext to wantonly launch labor projects and seek blessings to indulge private desires — may Your Majesty examine this.

s0197.literal: " The Emperor commended and accepted this.
s0197.idiomatic: The Emperor commended and accepted this.

s0198.literal: On gengzi day Shaanxi Branch Censorate associate director Yao Wei requested compilation of Shizu's excellent words and good deeds for timely review — approved.
s0198.idiomatic: On gengzi day Shaanxi Branch Censorate associate director Yao Wei requested compilation of Shizu's excellent words and good deeds for timely review — approved.

s0199.literal: Shenyang, Liaoyang, Daning routes and Jin and Fu prefectures had flooding; the people suffered famine; fifty thousand ingots of notes were granted in relief.
s0199.idiomatic: Shenyang, Liaoyang, Daning routes and Jin and Fu prefectures had flooding; the people suffered famine; 50,000 ingots of notes were granted in relief.

s0200.literal: Xiuwu County of Huaiqing had drought; its rent was remitted.
s0200.idiomatic: Xiuwu County of Huaiqing had drought; its rent was remitted.
